title: Every GTA 6 Region Before Launch Day
yt_title: Every GTA 6 Region You Can Visit Tomorrow #shorts
description:
GTA 6 launches November 19 on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. Here is a quick tour of the six regions Rockstar has named in Leonida: Vice City, the Leonida Keys, Grassrivers, Port Gellhorn, Ambrosia and Mount Kalaga National Park.

Map is fan-made and region spots are estimates. Screenshots: Rockstar Games.

#GTA6 #GTAVI #ViceCity #Leonida #Rockstar

lines.text: Tomorrow, GTA 6 finally drops you into Leonida.
And Rockstar has already named six regions.
It all starts in Vice City, their version of Miami.
Head south and you hit the Leonida Keys, where the story reportedly begins.
Then cut inland to the Grassrivers, swamps full of gators and airboats.
Over on the Gulf side is Port Gellhorn, full of run-down motels.
In the middle sits Ambrosia, refinery smoke and biker gangs.
And up north, Mount Kalaga, built for hunting and off-road trails.
Six regions, one state, and it all unlocks tomorrow.
So where are you going first?
